usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF (official exchange rate, period average)
usdRate.note: 2025 average 4.12 kina per US dollar (World Bank). The kina has weakened since: Trading Economics shows USD/PGK at 4.48 on 3 November 2026 and a high of 4.58 in October 2026. The Bank of PNG site could not be reached (HTTP 403), so no official 2026 rate is used.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics (PNG National Statistical Office quarterly CPI)
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: headline CPI up 2.2% year on year in the June quarter 2026 (2.2% in the March quarter). The NSO home page shows 3.5% for the September 2026 quarter without saying whether it is annual; the Bank of PNG site could not be reached (HTTP 403).

inflation_projection.sourceName: World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG (PNG CPI 4.4% in 2025); NSO/Trading Economics 2.2% in mid-2026
inflation_projection.note: The Bank of PNG has no numeric inflation target, and CPI has averaged roughly 4-5% over the last five years with a gradually weakening kina, so we plan with 4.5%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics (Bank of PNG Kina Facility Rate)
policy_rate.note: Secondary source: Kina Facility Rate last recorded at 5.00% (October 2026 reference); the Bank of PNG site returned HTTP 403.

savings_account_rate.note: Searched Bank of PNG (site blocked, HTTP 403) and large bank pages: savings rates are only published in a schedule we could not read; one bank advertises tiered savings 'up to 1.25%' plus bonus, which is not a typical rate.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Only an individual commercial bank's posted rate sheet showed a figure (about 0.6% for 3 months in late October 2026), and company pages are not used as sources; Bank of PNG interest rate statistics could not be reached (HTTP 403).

fdr_1y_rate.note: Only individual commercial banks' posted rate sheets showed a figure (about 0.9-1.2% for 12 months in late October 2026), and company pages are not used as sources; Bank of PNG interest rate statistics could not be reached (HTTP 403).

dps_rate.note: Searched bank savings and term deposit pages: no monthly recurring deposit (DPS-style) product with a published rate was found in PNG.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 0.26% in 2024 (figure older than 2025); Bank of PNG statistical tables could not be reached for a fresher figure.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Searched for a PNG government retail savings bond for individuals: none found; government securities are sold by Bank of PNG tender, mainly to institutions. Bank of PNG site unreachable (HTTP 403).

tbill_91d_rate.note: Bank of PNG auction results could not be reached (HTTP 403) and no secondary source with a current Treasury bill yield was found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: Bank of PNG Inscribed Stock tender results could not be reached (HTTP 403); no secondary source found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Bank of PNG Inscribed Stock tender results could not be reached (HTTP 403); no secondary source found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries: Papua New Guinea, individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest withholding tax of 15% on interest paid by financial institutions and the Central Bank; for residents it is creditable against final tax (residents pay 0% on the first PGK 20,000 of taxable income). Page last reviewed 23 September 2026.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government retail savings bond for individuals found, so no specific tax rule applies.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Searched for a PNG deposit insurance or deposit protection scheme: none in operation was found, and no source stating its absence was reachable.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap found; large banks do not publish card interest rates on their card pages (rates are in fee schedules we could not read).

equity_return_low.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
equity_return_low.note: Low case near the after-tax deposit rate (about 1% or less after the 15% withholding tax), because the local exchange (PNGX) has only a handful of thinly traded listings.

equity_return_base.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
equity_return_base.note: After-tax safe rate of about 0.8% (12-month bank deposits near 1% posted in late 2026, less 15% withholding) plus a premium kept under 4 points, since the local market is small, illiquid and has no long index record.

equity_return_high.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
equity_return_high.note: High case if dividend-paying resource and bank shares keep their recent record, still well below double digits given the thin market.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (kina per USD rose from about 3.3 in 2016 to 4.1 in 2025)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price with slower kina depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (kina per USD rose from about 3.3 in 2016 to 4.1 in 2025)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus kina depreciation of about 2-3% a year under the managed crawl.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (kina per USD rose from about 3.3 in 2016 to 4.1 in 2025)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and faster kina depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: short bank term deposits (posted rates well under 1% in late 2026) after the 15% interest withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 12-month bank term deposits at about 0.9-1.0% (posted rates, late 2026) less the 15% withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer term deposits or Treasury bills at about 1.5% after withholding tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Office of the Insurance Commissioner site has an expired certificate and no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold in PNG, but no published per-1,000 premium rates by age were found; insurers quote individually.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Searched for private hospital surgery or stay costs in Port Moresby: no published typical bill found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium table for PNG was found; plans are mainly sold to employer groups.

oop_health_share.note: 2023 figure (older than 2025), latest available in World Bank WDI.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG; NSO quarterly CPI
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI series found, so we plan with the 4.5% headline projection plus one point for private and imported medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG; NSO quarterly CPI
goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI series found, so we plan with the headline projection plus half a point for school fees.

life_expectancy.note: 2024 figure (older than 2025). UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 66.5 for 2026 (men 64.0, women 69.5).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026 (mid-year reference); totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (the page gives a total only at 65, 12.9).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.67 (2025, World Bank), 8.8 (2040) and 14.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/papua-new-guinea/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: Superannuation preservation age of 55 (with 65 as an alternative) is stated only on superannuation fund (company) pages, which are not used as sources; the Bank of PNG (superannuation regulator) and PacLII statute pages could not be reached (HTTP 403). PwC says PNG has no statutory social security system.

retirement_age_government.note: Searched for the PNG public service retirement age: no reachable official source (Department of Personnel Management) was found.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits after withholding tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the after-tax 12-month deposit rate (about 0.9% posted in late 2026 less 15% withholding), the best documented safe 1-year rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: World Bank FR.INR.DPST (PNG average deposit rate 0.26% in 2024); PwC: 15% interest withholding tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case: laddered longer deposits or Treasury bills after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Taka Plan mix of the PNG equity and fixed-income assumptions; World Bank FR.INR.DPST
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix: mostly deposits after tax with some local equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Taka Plan mix of the PNG equity and fixed-income assumptions; World Bank FR.INR.DPST
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly 60% local equity at the 4.5% base and 40% after-tax deposits at 0.8%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Taka Plan mix of the PNG equity and fixed-income assumptions; World Bank FR.INR.DPST
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: mostly equity at the upper end of its range.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries states that Papua New Guinea does not have a social security system (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/papua-new-guinea/individual/other-taxes, reviewed 23 September 2026); no national non-contributory old-age pension exists (some provinces have run their own small schemes).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No national non-contributory old-age pension: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries states that Papua New Guinea does not have a social security system (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/papua-new-guinea/individual/other-taxes).

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment for private employees found in PNG employment law; retirement savings run through compulsory superannuation.

public_pension_scheme.note: PNG has compulsory defined-contribution superannuation through licensed private funds (employee 6%, employer 8.4% for employers with 15 or more staff, PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/papua-new-guinea/individual/other-taxes, reviewed 23 September 2026), but no public pension; the access age could only be found on fund (company) pages, so the scheme rules are left missing.

savings_account.note: Ordinary kina savings accounts are offered by all commercial banks.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product is published by PNG banks.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government retail savings bond for individuals found; Treasury bills and Inscribed Stock are sold by Bank of PNG tender.

tbill_91d.note: Sold by Bank of PNG tender, mainly to institutions; 91-day bills are not always on offer.

tbond_5y.note: Sold by Bank of PNG tender, mainly to institutions.

tbond_10y.note: Sold by Bank of PNG tender, mainly to institutions.

equity_fund.note: A few locally managed unit trusts invest in shares on the small PNGX exchange and fixed income.

gold.note: PNG is a gold producer; buying gold is legal, mainly as jewellery or from licensed dealers.

insuranceComplaints.name: Office of the Insurance Commissioner
insuranceComplaints.note: No separate insurance ombudsman found; complaints go to the insurer, then the Commissioner.

pensionScheme.name: Compulsory superannuation (Superannuation (General Provisions) Act 2000), supervised by the Bank of PNG
pensionScheme.note: No public pension; compulsory superannuation is run by licensed private funds.

publicHealthCover.name: National Department of Health (public hospitals and health centres)

statistics.name: National Statistical Office of Papua New Guinea
